answer: A farm scripting its whole army of identities fires them together, which means the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 197 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. The saffron detector writes to ocean, and summit makes public every merge. Submissions that land within 268 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
